newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury rises as results match forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury rises as results match forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Cadbury Schweppes Plc rose 2p to 597-1/2p early on Wednesday after half-year results came out in line with expectations and the company reassured over its leading soft drink brands, analysts said.

"The figures are in line. The currency impact is in line and they've said Dr Pepper is trading well and 7-Up is showing better signs. We'll be waiting for what they say at the meeting but we won't be altering forecasts based on these figures," said one food analyst.
The company said it made pre-tax profit of 236 million stg against 231 million last time and compared with forecasts of 227-246 million. The impact of strong sterling took 16 million off earnings.
Cadbury said it was confident about its second half performance.
"These results perhaps only serve to confirm full-year estimates," said the analyst.
